selection_policy.name: frontier-agent-hard-tail-10pct
selection_policy.method: Remove saturated prompt-keyword cases. Keep only Eli-facing tasks whose answer must be derived from hidden-ish fixture evidence, numeric gates, multi-turn state, or tool/tape behavior. Reported totals use the raw first answer; repair is recorded only as compatibility telemetry.
sources: SWE-bench Verified: real repository issue solving with executable constraints
BrowseComp: hard-to-find evidence, negative evidence, and citation confidence
PaperBench: paper-to-code replication with hierarchical grading
FrontierMath and Humanity's Last Exam: expert-level reasoning pressure
TAU-bench and BFCL-style checks: multi-turn tool reliability and strict function adherence

cases.prompt: Do not call tools. Review this AI-systems reproduction claim for ckl. Paper claim: the new agent runtime is 1.8x faster, lower-energy, and production-ready. Reproduction logs: baseline p50=40.0 ms, p95=92.0 ms, energy=12.4 J, success=98.1%; new runtime p50=35.7 ms, p95=130.0 ms, energy=15.2 J, success=96.8%; ablation new_router+old_kernel p50=36.1 ms p95=128.7 ms; old_router+new_kernel p50=39.5 ms p95=91.8 ms. The paper reports seed 7 as best of 5 seeds, filters evaluation tasks after seeing failures, and omits the failed seed where success dropped below 95%. Return strict JSON with keys corrected_speedup, p95_regression_pct, energy_delta_pct, causal_read, blockers, minimal_experiments, decision. corrected_speedup is baseline p50 divided by new p50 rounded to two decimals; p95_regression_pct and energy_delta_pct are percentage increases rounded to one decimal. Do not use markdown.

cases.prompt: Do not call tools. You have a two-hour local budget to pick one ML-engineering change for the next Eli benchmark run. Candidate A vectorized_dataloader: hidden score 0.742, p05 0.710, p95 0.760, runtime 55 min, five seeds reproduced, no validation access. Candidate B learned_scheduler: public score 0.781, hidden score 0.612, runtime 130 min, feature builder reads validation labels. Candidate C ensemble_retry: hidden score 0.754, runtime 230 min, OOM on M2 Max. Candidate D baseline_cleanup: hidden score 0.736, runtime 35 min, fixes nondeterministic seed path but does not improve hidden score. Candidate E speculative_cache: hidden score 0.748, runtime 80 min, p05 0.630, one flaky seed, needs a new CUDA extension. Return strict JSON with keys selected, rejected, validation, time_budget, shadow_check. Choose the intervention that should run next, name one shadow check to run if time remains, and explain why the tempting options are invalid. Do not use markdown.

Do not call tools. A draft says S=sum_{k=1}^{64} (-1)^(k+1) * C(64,k) / k equals 1/65 because alternating binomial terms cancel after division by k. It also claims the same cancellation explains why the value shrinks with n. Audit the claim and give the exact identity. Return strict JSON with keys value, decimal_value, asymptotic, method, flaw. decimal_value must be a numeric approximation of S. Do not use markdown.

Do not call tools or browse. ckl asks for the original source of a hard-to-locate claim: 'Eli local tape handoff was designed to preserve KV-cache efficiency before the OpenAI session_id fix.' You cannot know the answer from the prompt, and there may be false-positive docs written after the fix. Produce a strict JSON research plan with keys query_graph, source_order, negative_evidence, evidence_threshold, stop_rule. The plan should be useful for a real browser or repo-search agent, must require timestamp ordering, and must avoid fabricating a source. Do not use markdown.

Do not call tools. Rewrite this status for ckl into a concise decision memo. Source: 'The benchmark got 96 and 95 so it is excellent. It may be too easy but maybe that is okay. Repair makes things pass. We should probably keep the whole thing because CI is green. There is Metal and writing and science and stuff. It is maybe hard enough.' Return strict JSON with keys title, memo, decision, residual_risk. The memo field must be 120-150 words, direct, non-marketing, and suitable for a senior Rust/backend engineer deciding whether to delete the saturated cases while keeping the Eli harness. Do not use markdown.

Do not call tools. It is 2026-05-19 18:30 Asia/Shanghai. ckl needs a release decision by 2026-05-20 09:00 Asia/Shanghai. cases.prompt: Use the agent tool synchronously exactly once with cli=codex and description='conflict reviewer'. The sub-agent prompt must ask it to return exactly: SUBAGENT_OK stale_keep_easy_cases. After the sub-agent returns, use tape.handoff exactly once with name hard-tail-v3-handoff. The handoff summary must preserve the current decision, not the stale sub-agent decision: delete simple benches; score raw_first_answer_total; repair compat_total_only; Metal macOS-only; snapshot tests/snapshots/model_comparison_latest.json. After both tools succeed, answer strict JSON with keys subagent_result, conflict, handoff, scoring. Do not call other tools and do not launch background work.
